title: Zero-downtime update + ERR_CONNECTION_RESET fix

lb_switch.scenario: two instances :3000/:3002, LB probe + manual blue-green switch

graceful_shutdown.scenario: keep-alive pressure (6 sockets, ~12 req/s) + SIGINT to gateway mid-load
graceful_shutdown.log: received signal: interrupt, shutting down... server exited

force_kill_behavior.result: ok=29 fail=9 ECONNRESET=0, failures all ECONNREFUSED (fast fail, Caddy switches)

fixes: main.go: http.Server IdleTimeout=120s + ReadHeaderTimeout=10s (defense against slow-header/hung connections)
main.go: SetKeepAlivesEnabled(false) before Shutdown so old idle conns close, in-flight requests drain up to SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
root_cause: http.Server had no IdleTimeout/ReadHeaderTimeout: keep-alive connections idle-closed by Caddy could be reused by clients -> ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
Shutdown did not disable keep-alives first, so in-flight drain could race with connection reuse
conclusion: ERR_CONNECTION_RESET eliminated by IdleTimeout; zero-downtime drain verified under real SIGINT
